facts.label: Discipline tree in the 10 Nov talent data
facts.value: Discipline: Power in Light, Twin Disciplines, Holy Precision, Soul Warding, Penance, Renewed Hope and Divine Aegis are new. Unbreakable Will, Improved Power Word: Fortitude, Divine Spirit and Force of Will are gone, and the other 11 talents changed.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Every Priest now learns Fear Ward and Devouring Plague at 20; in Classic they were Dwarf and Undead racials. Divine Spirit is baseline at 30 and Shadow Word: Death at 32.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Fade's threat drop is doubled. Prayer of Healing now heals the target's party and their pets instead of yours, and Renews from several Priests stack on one target.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Holy Precision gives Holy spells hit so healing Priests can skip hit gear, and Silent Resolve now also shortens Stun, Fear and Silence. Improved Power Word: Fortitude and Divine Spirit became baseline.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Shadowform now allows every non-healing spell, halves Shadow spell costs and doubles the crit damage bonus of Shadow spells, but its flat bonus is smaller (10% in the files vs Classic's 15%). Shadow Weaving now boosts only your own Shadow damage, so Shadow Priests no longer amplify Warlocks.

facts.label: Holy tree in the 10 Nov talent data
facts.value: Holy: Holy Binding, Litany of Light and Prayer of Mending are new. Improved Prayer of Healing and Lightwell are gone. Improved Renew, Holy Specialization, Spell Warding, Divine Fury and Holy Reach are unchanged from Classic 1.12, and the other 9 talents changed.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Penance was retuned on 8 Oct: less damage and healing, with mana costs set so it stays more efficient than Heal and Greater Heal.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Blizzard replaced Binding Heal with Holy Binding. Flash Heal on an ally also heals you for half the amount without generating threat. Shadow Word: Death costs 30% of maximum health when it hits without killing and deals no backlash on a miss.

facts.label: Shadow tree in the 10 Nov talent data
facts.value: Shadow: Improved Mind Flay, Dark Inspiration, Devouring Contagion and Early Demise are new. Shadow Affinity, Improved Fade and Improved Vampiric Embrace are gone. Blackout, Improved Mind Blast and Improved Shadow Word: Pain only moved, and the other 10 talents changed.

facts.label: Racial Priest spells (levels 10 and 20)
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern lists them as class-quest unlocks. Human: Divine Grace, Feedback. Dwarf: Desperate Prayer, Chastise. Night Elf: Starshards, Elune's Grace. Gnome: Confounding Flash, Contingency Plan.

facts.label: Baseline at level 20: Fear Ward and Devouring Plague
facts.value: Every Priest race learns both now. In the files Fear Ward lasts 3 min on a 3 min cooldown (talentsforever).

facts.label: Baseline at levels 30 and 32: Divine Spirit and Shadow Word: Death
facts.value: Both are baseline spells now. In the files Divine Spirit lasts 1 hour (was 30 min) and Prayer of Spirit covers the raid (talentsforever).

facts.label: Benediction and Anathema (Classic 1.12, level 60)
facts.value: Classic needs the Eye of Divinity (Majordomo Executus, Molten Core), the Eye of Shadow (Lord Kazzak or elite demons in the Blasted Lands and Winterspring) and Eris Havenfire's Splinter of Nordrassil quest. Unconfirmed in Forever: Molten Core is not a 9 Dec raid.

facts.label: Shadowmourne is not a Priest item
facts.value: Shadowmourne is a legendary two-handed axe from Wrath of the Lich King patch 3.3.0, usable by Paladins, Death Knights and Warriors. It is not a Classic item.

facts.label: Hit for Priests
facts.value: Holy Precision: up to 18% hit with Holy spells (6% per rank in the files); Blizzard added it so healing Priests can skip hit gear

facts.label: Soul Warding
facts.value: Soul Warding cuts Power Word: Shield's cooldown by 4 sec and its mana cost by 15%. It requires Improved Power Word: Shield.

facts.label: Penance
facts.value: 2 sec channel on a 12 sec cooldown; retuned on 8 Oct to stay more mana-efficient than Heal and Greater Heal

facts.label: Divine Aegis
facts.value: Divine Aegis: your non-periodic critical heals leave a shield on the target worth 5% of the amount healed per rank (15% at rank 3), absorbing up to 1,200 damage for 12 sec.

facts.label: Intellect
facts.value: Mental Strength gives 2-10% Intellect since 16 Oct

facts.label: Power Infusion
facts.value: Power Infusion raises the target's spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec. It requires Penance and has a 3 min cooldown.
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern expects it to stay in demand.

facts.label: Fear Ward for every Priest
facts.value: Every Priest race has Fear Ward at 20, so Alliance raids no longer depend on Dwarf Priests for it

facts.label: Raid buffs (files)
facts.value: Prayer of Fortitude, Prayer of Spirit and Prayer of Shadow Protection cover all party and raid members; Power Word: Fortitude's top rank is 70 Stamina (Classic: 54)
facts.note: talentsforever datamine. A Gamewave report on the 16 Oct beta patch says Fortitude is still cast per group, so check it in game.

facts.label: Threat: Silent Resolve
facts.value: Silent Resolve: your spells generate 10% less threat per rank, up to 30% at rank 3.

facts.label: Prayer of Healing
facts.value: Heals the target's party and their pets, so you can cover a group you are not in

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: From 9 Dec 2026: The Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40, each raider carries a Drakefire Amulet)

facts.label: Onyxia
facts.value: Blizzard tells raids to build fire resistance before Onyxia's Lair and gives no target number

facts.label: Classic 1.12 healer kit (reference)
facts.value: Flask of Distilled Wisdom, Elixir of the Sages, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic or Dark Rune, Nightfin Soup, Runn Tum Tuber Surprise, Sagefish Delight, wizard oils

facts.label: Forever alchemy
facts.value: Healing potions moved to First Aid, new elixirs include Minor Arcane Elixir, and flasks are brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones; you sit at the camp for at least 1 minute
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern. Whether they last into raids is not stated.

facts.label: World buffs in raids
facts.value: Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer is marked 'No effect while in a raid instance' in Forever data

facts.label: Spiritual Guidance
facts.value: Spiritual Guidance raises your spell healing by up to 5% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 1% of it at rank 1, rising to 25% and 8% at rank 5.

facts.label: Human Spirit racial
facts.value: +10% Spirit in the 26 Oct notes

facts.label: Spiritual Healing
facts.value: Spiritual Healing has 3 ranks: your spells heal 3% more at the first and 10% more at the third.

facts.label: Improved Healing
facts.value: Improved Healing makes Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance and Prayer of Mending cost 5% less per rank, up to 15% at rank 3.

facts.label: Prayer of Mending
facts.value: 10 sec cooldown; heals on the next damage taken or non-periodic heal, then jumps within 20 yards, up to 5 heals and one per target

facts.label: Heal values (files)
facts.value: From level 20 heals start lower than in Classic; the largest Greater Heal is about 6% under Classic for the same mana

facts.label: Renew stacking
facts.value: Renews from several Priests can stack on one target

facts.label: Prayer of Healing
facts.value: Heals the target's party and their pets, so you can heal a group you are not in

facts.label: Raid buffs (files)
facts.value: Prayer of Fortitude, Prayer of Spirit and Prayer of Shadow Protection reach every party and raid member
facts.note: talentsforever datamine. A Gamewave report on the 16 Oct beta patch says Fortitude is still cast per group, so check it in game.

facts.label: Threat
facts.value: Fade's threat drop is doubled

facts.label: Healer rankings
facts.note: Icy Veins lists raid healer rankings as TBD, and no Forever raid logs exist yet.

facts.label: Onyxia
facts.value: Every raider carries their own Drakefire Amulet, and Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance before the fight

facts.label: Shadow hit from talents
facts.value: Shadow Focus adds 1% hit with Shadow spells per rank and has 5 ranks.
facts.note: Blizzard moved it to row 1 and switched it from resist reduction to hit.

facts.label: Spell hit cap against raid bosses (Forever)
facts.note: No official Forever value has been published.

facts.label: Classic 1.12 hit cap (reference only)
facts.value: 16% spell hit against bosses three levels higher; 1% of spells always miss

facts.label: Extra hit for Dwarves
facts.value: Artisan's Precision gives 1% hit with spells and attacks (added 26 Oct)
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern advises Shadow to cap hit as soon as possible.

facts.label: Shadowform
facts.value: Shadowform adds 10% Shadow damage, makes Shadow spells cost 50% less, adds 100% to the critical strike damage bonus of Shadow spells and cuts Physical damage taken by 15%. You cannot cast healing spells in it.

facts.label: Darkness
facts.value: Darkness adds 2% Shadow damage per rank and has 5 ranks.

facts.label: Shadow Weaving is personal
facts.value: It now boosts only your own Shadow damage, so Shadow Priests no longer amplify Warlocks
facts.note: In the files: 2% per stack up to 10% with 3 ranks (Classic: raid-wide, 3% per stack up to 15%).

facts.label: Group utility
facts.value: Vampiric Embrace, Dark Inspiration, Prayer buffs, Psychic Scream, Fear Ward, disease removal, Dispel Magic, Mind Control and Shackle Undead

facts.label: Vampiric Embrace
facts.value: Heals your party for 20% of your Shadow damage for 30 sec; 30 sec cooldown and no longer resistible since 16 Oct

facts.label: Dark Inspiration
facts.value: Dark Inspiration: Mind Blast and a fully channeled Mind Flay raise your and your party's Spirit by 3% for 10 sec at rank 1, up to 15% at rank 5.

facts.label: DPS rankings
facts.note: Icy Veins lists raid DPS rankings as TBD, and no Forever raid logs exist yet.

facts.label: Classic 1.12 caster kit (reference)
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Brilliant Wizard Oil, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic or Dark Rune, Nightfin Soup, Runn Tum Tuber Surprise
